title: Using an intersectional framework to explore cannabis and tobacco co-use patterns: Protocol for a descriptive study
author: Fennell, Cottrell-Daniels, et al.
materials: are able to read and understand English

steps.title: Define eligibility criteria
steps.instruction: Specify that participants must be (1) age ≥ 18 years, (2) residents of the United States (all 50 states, Washington D.C., or Puerto Rico), (3) able to read and understand English, and (4) have used any form of tobacco/nicotine in the past 30 days. Program the survey to automatically redirect anyone who is under 18, does not provide an age, does not reside in the U.S., selects an invalid state/territory, or reports no tobacco use in the past month out of the study.

steps.title: Set recruitment quotas
steps.instruction: Establish recruitment targets for the sample as follows: >45 % female, >45 % male; ≈20 % Non‑Hispanic Black, ≈20 % Hispanic of any race, >40 % Non‑Hispanic White; and a “good distribution” across U.S. Census regions matching national shares (Northeast ~17 %, South ~45 %, Midwest ~22 %, West ~16 %). Program CloudResearch to enforce these quotas during participant enrollment.

steps.title: Create recruitment advertisement
steps.instruction: Post the study on CloudResearch Prime Panels using the title “Multiple Health Behaviors” (not a tobacco‑specific label) to minimise selection bias and fraudulent entries.

steps.title: Build Qualtrics survey
steps.instruction: Design the online survey in Qualtrics with the following sections in order: (a) Informed consent page, (b) Inclusion‑criteria screen (age, U.S. residence, past‑month tobacco use), (c) Main questionnaire covering tobacco/nicotine use, nicotine dependence, quit motivation/intentions, alcohol use, exercise, pain, cannabis use, other drug use, and chronic health conditions.

steps.title: Program ineligible redirect
steps.instruction: Configure Qualtrics logic so that participants who fail any inclusion criterion are automatically redirected out of the survey and do not see any further questions.

steps.title: Add cannabis‑specific module
steps.instruction: Insert a conditional block that is shown only to participants who indicate past‑year cannabis use. This block should collect detailed measures of cannabis use, cannabis‑related problems, cannabis‑tobacco co‑use, cannabis use stereotypes, cannabis expectancies, and sources of cannabis information.

steps.title: Finalize survey flow
steps.instruction: At the end of the questionnaire, add a redirect that sends participants back to CloudResearch Prime Panels so they can receive compensation from the panel they originally entered.

steps.title: Handle participant compensation
steps.instruction: Allow the panel to compensate participants according to the original agreement (e.g., reward points, cash payment, or charitable donation). No additional compensation handling is required within Qualtrics.
